scope: Three complete notices, nine unique PDF pages; original two pages were also inspected before this follow-up.
render_warnings: Poppler reported missing display fonts Symbol and ArialUnicode for the seven new renders; financial/date glyphs and table borders were visibly legible.

records.observation: Printed original notice is 2024-043. Summary says 1.2 yuan per share; body says 1.2 yuan per 10 shares. Total is printed as no more than 127,445,287.56 yi-yuan. These are source contradictions, not extraction repairs. Summary preserves aggregate and changes per-share payment if total capital changes.

Body continues with unchanged per-share payment and adjusted aggregate, conflicting with the summary. Board approval is 2024-08-29, signature 2024-08-31. Actual entitlement dates are deferred to the implementation notice.

Corrected notice 2024-048 fixes summary to 0.12 yuan per share, aggregate to 127,445,287.56 yuan and removes the no-more-than qualifier. Summary now preserves per-share payment and changes aggregate when eligible share base changes; body trigger also refers to eligible base. Total 1,070,044,063 less 8,000,000 repurchased equals 1,062,044,063 eligible shares. Body per 10 shares remains 1.2 yuan. Actual dates are deferred.
Continuation agrees with unchanged per-share payment and adjusted aggregate. Board date and no-extra-shareholder-vote authorization agree with the original. Signature is 2024-09-03, not 2024-08-31.

Implementation notice 2024-053. A share 600754 pays CNY 0.12; B share 900934 pays USD 0.016872. Date table: A record 2024-09-26, last-trade dash, cash payment 2024-09-27; B record 2024-10-08, last trade 2024-09-26, cash payment 2024-10-18. Ex-date 2024-09-27 is a single merged cell spanning both rows. Board approval and prior authorization identify the same 2024 half-year scheme.

Cash-only scheme: 1.20 yuan per 10 shares, no bonus shares or capitalization. Eligible base and CNY aggregate agree with corrected proposal. Diluted ex-reference uses eligible/total shares and is printed approximately 0.12, distinct from exact recipient payment. Formula continues on page 3.

Repeated A/B date table agrees with page 1, including the merged ex-date cell. Generic share-crediting language does not override explicit cash-only scheme. Self-payment party is Shanghai Jinjiang Capital. A-share natural-person tax depends on holding duration and is not withheld at payment; no competition tax rule is inferred.

A-share resident companies receive CNY 0.12, QFII and Stock Connect descriptions CNY 0.108. B-share payment is USD at stated 2024-08-30 rate 1:7.1124; gross 0.016872, non-resident-company net 0.015185. These amounts are not interchangeable with A-share gross cash.

B-share resident natural-person tax wording continues; foreign individuals receive USD 0.016872 under the stated source rule. Contact section and signature 2024-09-21 end the notice. No amendment or different scheme follows.

prior_note_correction.correction: Original is 2024-043; 2024-048 is the corrected proposal. The frozen provisional note is preserved.

disposition: The original conflicts are superseded for this scheme by the corrected proposal and later implementation. This corroborates the existing A-share payment record; it does not accept new fields or resolve other periods.
